title: Late-Payment Share, CondoGuard Deductible Credit
content:
Billing office rule of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy linking late fees to the credit for a deductible raise.

**Rule.** The late-payment share of the deductible credit counts the late fees charged on the policy fewer than 12 whole months before the day of the raise: it is 0.80 for two or more, 0.90 for exactly one, and 1.00 for none. The share is applied to the product of the annual premium in force and the deductible step credit, before the full-year deductible credit is rounded. Where that product carries more than one deductible credit share, the shares are first multiplied together and then applied once to the product; none of them acts on the result of another.

**Entries read.** Late fee entries on the policy's premium account, by the date each was charged; each late fee counts once.

| Late fees charged in the 12 whole months before the raise | Late-payment share |
|---|---|
| two or more | 0.80 |
| exactly one | 0.90 |
| none | 1.00, no late-payment reduction |

## Cases (hypothetical accounts)

- Late fees charged 2 and 11 whole months before the raise: two, 0.80.
- One late fee charged 11 whole months before and one 12 whole months before: only the first is within the time, 0.90.
- Returned-payment fees and installment fees are not late fees and are not counted; an account with only those has none, 1.00.
